newsitem.title: FINLAND: OUTOKUMPU WINS FIM 35 MLN CHINESE ORDER.
newsitem.headline: OUTOKUMPU WINS FIM 35 MLN CHINESE ORDER.

text.p: Finnish metals and mining group Outokumpu Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had won a flash smelting technology order from Chinese Jiangxi Copper Corporation.
"The value of the agreements ... amounts to about 35 million markka (about $8 million)," it said.

Outokumpu said it would supply engineering, proprietary equipment and technical services for the expansion of Jiangxi Copper's Guixi smelter and technical services including supervision, stat-up assistance and training.
"The first stage of this expansion is expected to be started up at the end of 1997," it said.
